rationale: Both languages passed all 10 acceptance cases. The Guion implementation supports concurrent probes, per-request timeouts, and JSON plus human-readable output; the Python reference uses a thread pool and deadline-bounded reads.
task: Build an internal inventory of device endpoints, querying each concurrently under a hard deadline and writing a human-readable health digest.
trial_observation: Seven randomized pairs: Guion 0.537813s, Python 0.642550s; ratio 0.840 (95% interval 0.828–0.845). Both passed 10/10 cases.
caveat: The fixed network timeout dominates this selected case. The preference result is exploratory and unblinded.
